s0.en: There are {n} checks: {listing}. A record lists two alleles of the first parent, two of the second parent, and two of the child. Alleles are chosen from 0, 1, and 2. s1.en: There are {n} checks: {listing}. A record lists two alleles of the first parent, two of the second parent, and two of the child. Alleles are chosen from 0, 1, and 2.
